units: <cite ref="Pesachim 118b">Pes. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>שחוֹלֶדֶת בעיקרי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. as in <cite ref="Chullin 20b:8">Ḥull. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>הדרה</he>) which undermines the foundations &c. V. <cite ref="H00330"><he>חוּלְדָּה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="H00979">same</cite>. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ top <he>מַחִלִיד הב״ה … את וכ׳</he> the Lord caves the ground before them and they roll &c.; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ top <he>מהלך … אל</he> (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 19b:2">B. Bath. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני שמַחְלִידִין וכ׳</he> because their roots undermine the ground.

senses.gloss: to pass the slaughtering knife under cover, to squeeze in.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 5</cite> <he>מפני שהכובס אומן מַחֲלִידוֹ לתוכו</he> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 21:1">Kel.
